source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Clearly identify the vehicle being inspected (make, model, VIN number).
3. Document the date and time of the inspection.
4. Record the name of the inspector and their qualifications.
5. Detail the environment and conditions during the inspection (weather, road conditions, etc.).
6. Specify the component of the brake system that failed.
7. Describe the test(s) and method(s) used to determine the failure.
8. List the specific failure point (e.g., leaky brake line, worn pads, defective ABS sensor).
9. Include the readings and measurements from the failed brake test (such as brake gauge readings).
10. Record any noted warning signs of brake failure (e.g., uneven wear, noise, vibration).
11. Describe any observations and symptoms noted by the inspector during the test drive.
12. Document any attempts at temporary fixes or repairs during the inspection, and the results.
